rows.title: Coenzyme Q10 supplementation restores mitochondrial respiration in patients with primary CoQ10 deficiency caused by novel COQ2 and COQ4 variants.
rows.focus: Patients with genetically confirmed primary CoQ10 deficiency showed impaired mitochondrial respiration; after three months of CoQ10 supplementation, one previously untreated proband showed improved ATP-linked respiration, reduced proton leak, and neurological improvement. Benefit is disease-specific and not generalizable to healthy users.

rows.title: Vitamin D Deficiency and 3-Year Risk of New-Onset Depression After Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery: A Longitudinal Cohort Study.
rows.focus: In a propensity-matched retrospective cohort of 11,805 pairs after metabolic/bariatric surgery, vitamin D deficiency was associated with higher 3-year incident depression risk. This observational association does not establish that vitamin D correction prevents depression.
